summary: Module 05 (en) technical review done. Every derivation, worked example, check and answer in s1-s13, every exercise solution and every quiz answer and explanation was recomputed, with independent scripts (tools/labpy.sh, scratch folder m05review) wherever arithmetic is involved: the Gaussian KL formula and 1.1534/0.5966; the exact ELBO example (log p(x) = -2.2655, ELBO -2.2655 and -3.4189, gap 1.1534); the two-step noising box (2.0125, N(1.6, 0.36)); score-function variance 30 against 4; linear-AE covariance and MSE 1.0; KL 0.8181 + 0.125 = 0.9431; the beta = 4 comparison (35.4 against 27.2); GAN three-point V = -0.6931, JSD 0.3466, saturation -0.01/-0.99; both schedules' alpha-bar tables, the half-signal points (t = 260 and 497), the -20 dB crossings (674 and 936; 33% and 6.5%), SNR -10.7/-0.1 dB, the ELBO weights 0.50/0.010/0.0055/0.010, Lab 2's capped schedule (6.83e-5, 1.41, 121) and the T = 200 linear endpoint 0.132; the posterior-mean derivation coefficients; the Gaussian denoiser (-0.4686, 1.8828 both ways); the Gaussian DDIM experiment re-simulated (std 0.50 ancestral; 0.47, 0.37, 0.16, 0.002 for 50/10/3/1 steps); CFG arithmetic and the (1 + w) convention; latent compression 48; evaluation counts; A-hat and A-hat X of the five-node tree, its eigenvalues (1, 0.7655, 0.5, 0.0974, -0.2795) and the cosine table (0.300; 0.846 ... 1.000); the explorer's 12-node tree (lambda_1 = 3.392, 3.392^8 = 1.75e4, largest feature 12,246 = 1.22e4 at k = 8; bipartite cosines 0.455, 0.384, 0.762, 0.661, 0.832, limit 0.976); the explorer's DDIM ring claim (re-simulated with its exact mixture denoiser: cosine degrades more slowly, linear at 3 steps lands between clusters); GAT softmax (0.318, 0.524, 0.158); PINN residual 7.90, mean r^2 31.2 (31.0 on 200 points), non-dimensional 0.02, omega_d 6.252, envelope 0.285, RMS 0.44; solve_ivp 6.8e-9 (7.1e-7 with default atol); the hard-constraint extension re-run (0.0896 at 10,000 steps); FNO 32,768 + 1,056 = 33,824 (97%) and numel 17,440; InfoNCE (0.445, 0.810, 0.577; 0.9987, 0.0013, 1.385; log 256 = 5.55); Mixtral 176.2M, 45.1B, 41.9M, 1.34B, 0.26B, 46.7B, 11.3B, 12.9B, router 1.05M, norms 0.27M, ratio 3.6, 93/26 GB; balancing loss 2.8 and 1.0; exercises e2 (2.020 nats and the split table), e3 (5.0 nats, 7.2 bits, 99.8%), e4, e5, e6, e7 (series corrections 0.067/0.0067), e8 (all of (a)-(d), including the -0.25 decay and the leaf-feature 0.5^k case), e10 (spectra and triangle counts), e11 (residual algebra, 0.3948, 0.0288/0.0291), e12, e14, e15 (0.5216, 4.17, +1.07, -0.19). All 8 exercise code blocks with output fences were run: e4, e5, e6, e7, e8 and e11 reproduce exactly; e12 reproduces every number (only the wall-clock seconds, 72 against 69, differ, which the text already labels approximate); e9's GCN test accuracy reproduces deterministically as 0.8306 (1 or 4 threads) against the fence's 0.8276, an environment difference, so the fence was updated (the prose's '0.83' stands). Every number quoted from the labs in the concept text, What goes wrong, exercises, quiz and summary matches the labs' printed outputs. All 18 figures' SVG text was read and fig-05-1, 5, 9, 11, 13 and 28 rendered: every figure agrees with its caption and with the text's numbers (fig-05-20's vectors (0.80, 1.30) and (0.74, 1.49) and fig-05-28's renormalised weights 0.62/0.38 recomputed). Cross-references: all in-page section, lab, exercise and figure references resolve; links to Modules 01 s5/s6/s10/s11, 02 s4, 03 s2/s8/s12, 04 s9, 06 s5/s6 (and Module 06's BERT and cross-attention) cover what is claimed; 07, 08 (s5 covers MoE at scale) and 10 per BRIEF ownership. Citations and years checked against the reference list (every cited work is listed); dated claims are marked as of 2026. CANONICAL M05 notes are all applied (e8(d), the 3.392^8 vs 1.22e4 check, reading runs split in the plan, omega_0 = 2 pi throughout). Public-site rules: three references to 'the source tutorial' (an internal document the reader cannot see) were removed. Six fixes in all; node tools/check.mjs --module 5 --lang en --words reports 0 errors, 0 warnings.

issues: The plan's non-display fields (sections[].must_cover and worked_examples of s6, s8, s9, s11, s13; what_goes_wrong; labs[].steps and expected_observations; writer note (f)) still quote planning-prototype lab numbers superseded by the reconciled text (carried over from m05-edit.json, unchanged here). Proposed fix: one plan-sync pass copying the numbers from the text, or a note in the plan that they are planning values.

Lab 4's non-dimensional and weighted runs oscillate at a fixed Adam learning rate, so the 'ten times better' comparison holds only at the 7,500-step snapshot (the text says so). A cosine learning-rate decay in Steps 5-6 would give a clean comparison but changes lab code and every Lab 4 number quoted in s9, What goes wrong and the quiz. Proposed fix: decide in the next lab pass (carried over).

Exercise output fences are not executed by tools/labrun.py, so drift is not detected by the build: e9's GCN accuracy already moved (0.8276 to 0.8306) between environments, and e12 differs only in wall-clock seconds. Proposed fix: re-run the eight exercise blocks whenever PyTorch or NumPy changes, or soften e9's printed accuracy to two decimals.
Timing claims depend on the machine: solve_ivp took 18 ms here against the text's 'about 30 ms', and e12's trainings 72 s against 'about 70 s'. Both are labelled approximate; no change made.
